# The Jewelry Magazine

> > The Jewelry Magazine delivers comprehensive coverage of the global fine jewelry industry, from diamond mining and luxury auctions to designer collections and market trends.

The Jewelry Magazine (TJM) provides industry news, market analysis, and trend reporting for jewelry professionals and enthusiasts. Coverage spans major jewelry houses like Cartier, Tiffany & Co., and Harry Winston, diamond production from Botswana and global markets, auction results from Sotheby's, designer profiles, and retail financial performance from companies like Signet Jewelers.

## Key Topics

- Luxury Jewelry
- Diamond Mining & Production
- Botswana Mining Operations
- Designer Jewelry Collections
- Jewelry Trends & Fashion
- Auction Houses (Sotheby's)
- Major Jewelry Brands (Cartier, Tiffany & Co., Harry Winston)
- Fine Jewelry Market Analysis
- Gold Jewelry & Gold Policy
- Colored Gemstones & Emeralds
- JCK Trade Shows
- Jewelry Industry Financial Results
- Historic Jewelry & Collectors
- GJEPC (Gem & Jewellery Export Promotion Council)
- GST Impact on Jewelry Trade

## Diamond Industry & Mining

- [Graff acquires 373ct diamond from Botswana](https://www.thejewelrymagazine.com/graff-acquires-373ct-diamond-botswana): Graff Diamonds acquires 373ct Type IIa diamond from Karowe mine, Botswana
- [Botswana's H1 Rough Diamond Production Dips 8.5% Y-o-Y](https://www.thejewelrymagazine.com/botswanas-h1-rough-diamond-production-dips): Botswana rough diamond production falls 8.5% in H1 2017 per Bank of Botswana
- [De Beers Will Invest in Start-Ups](https://www.thejewelrymagazine.com/de-beers-will-invest-start-ups): De Beers Ventures launches to invest in diamond industry startups
- [De Beers Launches 3rd Party B2B Polished Diamond Sales Pilot Project](https://www.thejewelrymagazine.com/de-beers-launches-3rd-party-b2b-polished-diamond-sales-pilot-project): De Beers Auction Sales pilots third-party B2B polished diamond platform
- [Firestone Diamonds Lowers Operational Loss in FY '16](https://www.thejewelrymagazine.com/firestone-diamonds-lowers-operational-loss-fy-16-net-profit-13-9-mn-tax-credit): Firestone Diamonds FY2016 results: reduced operational loss, Liqhobong mine

## Auctions & Historic Jewelry

- [Historic 'Stotesbury Emerald' Sells at Sotheby's](https://www.thejewelrymagazine.com/historic-stotesbury-emerald-sells-sothebys): Historic Stotesbury Emerald auction at Sotheby's New York with Cartier heritage

## Market Analysis & Financial News

- [WGC: Q1 2017 Global Gold Jewellery Demand Flat; India, US Gain, China Still Slow](https://www.thejewelrymagazine.com/wgc-q1-2017-global-gold-jewellery-demand-flat-india-us-gain-china-still-slow): World Gold Council Q1 2017 report: global gold jewelry demand flat at 481t
- [Signet Jewelers' Sales and Profits for Q1 Fiscal 2018 Decline Y-o-Y](https://www.thejewelrymagazine.com/signet-jewelers-sales-and-profits-for-q1-fiscal-2018-decline-y-o-y): Signet Jewelers Q1 FY2018 earnings report shows sales and profit decline
- [Tiffany & Co. Makes Bank of America's List of Hot Stocks](https://www.thejewelrymagazine.com/tiffany-co-makes-bank-americas-list-hot-stocks): Tiffany & Co. added to Bank of America Merrill Lynch US 1 hot stocks list
- [Proposed Comprehensive Gold Policy in Focus at India International Gold Convention](https://www.thejewelrymagazine.com/proposed-comprehensive-gold-policy-focus-india-international-gold-convention): IIGC 2017 in Goa focuses on India's comprehensive gold policy and GST impact

- [7 Jewelry Trends That Will Define 2017](https://www.thejewelrymagazine.com/7-jewelry-trends-will-define-2017): 2017 jewelry trends: statement earrings, enamel, pearls, and charm necklaces
- [Las Vegas List: Collar Necklaces](https://www.thejewelrymagazine.com/las-vegas-list-collar-necklaces): JCK Las Vegas collar necklace trends from Cassis, Sabatini, Gabriel & Co.
- [Pantone Color-Blocking Report 8 of 10: Jewels to Color-Block with Pantone's Niagara](https://www.thejewelrymagazine.com/pantone-color-blocking-report-8-10-jewels-color-block-pantones-niagara): Pantone Spring 2017 Niagara blue jewelry color-blocking styling guide
- [Walk the Line: Tiered Drop Earrings](https://www.thejewelrymagazine.com/walk-line-tiered-drop-earrings): Tiered drop earring trend from Anzie, Sabatini, Bronfman, and more designers
